extracted.intended_audience: Montana businesses, registered voters, notaries, and general Montana residents seeking Secretary of State services or election information
extracted.subtask_description: Official Montana Secretary of State office homepage providing service announcements, election notices, business filing information, notary/apostille guidance, and consumer alerts. The page informs the public about deadlines, fee waivers, ballot tracking, and where to find procedural resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scam/Impostor Notice about annual report fees
rubrics_metrics.description: If you received a letter stating you owe money to file an annual report or purchase a certificate, it is NOT affiliated with our office. Throw it away, and do not pay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page displays examples (e.g., a business document from National Business Services, a reminder email from US Filing Services) and explicitly warns that such solicitations are not affiliated with the Secretary of State. Users are instructed to discard the notices and not remit payment. This functions as an authenticity check and consumer-protection instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2026 Annual Report Fee Waiver Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Secretary of State Christi Jacobsen waived the 2026 Annual Report filing fee for all businesses that file between January 1 and April 15, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Businesses filing their 2026 Annual Report within the stated window are eligible for a waived filing fee; the page links to 'File Your Annual Report' and 'More Information on Fee Waiver' for details and the filing portal. This establishes a clear temporal eligibility criterion for the waiver.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual Report Filing — filing portal and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Business registrations and everything you need to start, maintain, and grow your business in Montana; includes links to file annual reports and to the Filing Portal Login.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides pathways (Business Services Home Page, File Your Annual Report, Filing Portal Login) for completing required filings and suggests the office handles annual report processing. While not listing step-by-step rules on this page, it signals where to complete filings and access official instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ballot Tracking and Absentee Ballot Notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Absentee ballots for Montana's June 2nd Primary Election are en route to mailboxes across the state; active, registered absentee voters can expect arrival in the coming days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs voters to 'Track Your Ballot Now' to verify the status of their absentee or mail ballot. This provides a procedural resource for voters to confirm delivery and status of ballots (informational, not evaluative).

rubrics_metrics.name: Late Registration Period and Expanded Registration/Voting Availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Montana enters late registration period for the June 2nd Primary Election; county election offices across the state are open for expanded registration and voting on specified dates (e.g., Saturday, May 30th).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announces the existence of a late registration window and specific county office availability; voters are advised of dates and locations to register or vote in-person during the late registration period. This is a temporal and location-based eligibility/availability criterion for voter registration and voting services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notary Services — commission maintenance and statutory compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintaining a Notary Commission, Accessing Montana Notary Statutes and Administrative Rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links to Notary Home Page and 'Search For a Notary'; references that changes may occur per legislation (e.g., 'View changes per House Bill 165'). This indicates that notary practices must comply with Montana statutes and administrative rules and points users to official resources for requirements and updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apostilles & Authentications — state certification requirement for foreign use
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides state certification for notarized or certified documents that are to be sent to, or used in, a foreign country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs users to the Apostilles Home Page for procedures to obtain state certification. This sets the functional requirement that documents intended for foreign use must receive appropriate state authentication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Rules — deadlines, emergency rules, and notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadlines, emergency rules, rule notices, issues, and more are available via the Administrative Rules Home Page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page indicates where to find rulemaking-related deadlines and notices; users seeking to submit or track administrative rules should consult the Administrative Rules Home Page for procedural timelines and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business & UCC Filings — scope of services and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Business registrations and everything you need to start, maintain, and grow your business in Montana.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links to Business Services Home Page and related resources (e.g., UCC filings). This sets an expectation of available services and where to find forms, registration steps, and guidance for compliance with state business filing requirements.
